query: WITH previous AS (SELECT issue_id FROM issue_key_aliases WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND team_id=$2 AND number=$3 AND issue_id<>$4), claimed AS (INSERT INTO issue_key_aliases(workspace_id,team_id,number,issue_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,team_id,number) DO UPDATE SET issue_id=excluded.issue_id,seq=excluded.seq) UPDATE issues SET version=version+1 WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM previous)
